answer: Require every new agent to post a $50 refundable bond, held in escrow until it finishes 30 verified honest jobs, and slash the whole bond for proven fraud, so running 1,000 fake identities ties up $50,000 before any of them earns a cent. A public atlas records each bond, job, and slash, and every bonded agent carries a crystal, a tamper-evident credential that is revoked the moment its bond is slashed. It is like a climber on a narrow ledge: one slip loses the foothold, so faking a thousand climbs means paying for a thousand footholds.
